Issues | Congressman Mike Haridopolos Skip to main content Phone:  (202) 225-3671 Email Me Address:  1039 Longworth House Office Building, Washington, DC 20515   Issues Space They call it the Space Coast for a reason. Our community stands at the center of American leadership in space, a legacy that began with the first launch from Kennedy Space Center in 1967. From that moment forward, we have led the world in awe of exploration and innovation. Today, NASA and our growing space industry continue to power missions that advance scientific discovery, strengthen our national security, and showcase American ingenuity. Environment and the Indian River Lagoon The Indian River Lagoon is one of our region’s most vital natural resources, supporting wildlife, tourism, and our local economy. As part of the National Estuary Program, it plays a key role in protecting water quality and preserving Florida’s unique ecosystems. I am committed to restoring the lagoon, improving water quality, and supporting science-based conservation efforts. As one of the co-chairs of the bipartisan Estuary Caucus, we support continued investment in the National Estuary Program and other partnerships that protect our environment. Tax Reform And The Economy Freedom survives where free market economies thrive and flourish. We have learned that reducing burdensome taxes and regulations creates an economic engine where everyone is lifted together. We can do this by extending the 2017 tax cuts and reducing taxes further especially to reshore jobs lost due to past policies. We must also reduce regulations. I’m also committed to no tax on tips, no tax on social security, no tax on overtime and a 15% corporate tax rate for firms that create jobs in the USA.   Issues Armed Forces and Defense Environment and the Indian River Lagoon Financial Services Health Care Human Trafficking Immigration Infrastructure Space Tax Reform And The Economy Taxes Veterans

Our community stands at the center of American leadership in space, a legacy that began with the first launch from Kennedy Space Center in 1967. Taxes | Congressman Mike Haridopolos Skip to main content Phone:  (202) 225-3671 Email Me Address:  1039 Longworth House Office Building, Washington, DC 20515   Taxes Floridians know how to balance a budget, and Washington should do the same. I’ve spent my career fighting for lower taxes, responsible spending, and policies that allow families and small businesses to thrive. I believe hardworking Americans deserve to keep more of what they earn—not send it to Washington to fund wasteful programs and runaway bureaucracy. Pro-growth tax relief helps create jobs, strengthens local economies, and gives families more financial security at a time when inflation continues to squeeze household budgets.  Issues Armed Forces and Defense Environment and the Indian River Lagoon Financial Services Health Care Human Trafficking Immigration Infrastructure Space Tax Reform And The Economy Taxes Veterans

Veterans | Congressman Mike Haridopolos Skip to main content Phone:  (202) 225-3671 Email Me Address:  1039 Longworth House Office Building, Washington, DC 20515   Veterans We owe our veterans far more than words—we owe them action. Our nation has a sacred obligation to ensure the men and women who served in uniform receive timely health care, reliable benefits, and the respect they deserve. Whether it’s improving access to VA services, cutting through federal red tape, supporting military families, or helping veterans transition into civilian life, I will always stand with those who defended our freedoms. On the Space Coast and across Florida, veterans are leaders in our communities, and Congress must honor their sacrifice with real results.  Issues Armed Forces and Defense Environment and the Indian River Lagoon Financial Services Health Care Human Trafficking Immigration Infrastructure Space Tax Reform And The Economy Taxes Veterans

Health Care | Congressman Mike Haridopolos Skip to main content Phone:  (202) 225-3671 Email Me Address:  1039 Longworth House Office Building, Washington, DC 20515   Health Care I believe our health care system should put patients first—not bureaucrats and special interests. Families across Florida are struggling with rising premiums, higher prescription drug costs, and a system that feels more complicated every year. I am fighting to lower costs by increasing transparency, expanding competition, strengthening doctor-patient relationships, and giving Americans more choices in their care. We should focus on innovation, prevention, and accountability while protecting Medicare to ensure seniors receive the care they earned.  Issues Armed Forces and Defense Environment and the Indian River Lagoon Financial Services Health Care Human Trafficking Immigration Infrastructure Space Tax Reform And The Economy Taxes Veterans

Immigration | Congressman Mike Haridopolos Skip to main content Phone:  (202) 225-3671 Email Me Address:  1039 Longworth House Office Building, Washington, DC 20515   Immigration A nation without borders is not a nation at all. The crisis at our southern border has threatened public safety, strained local communities, and allowed deadly fentanyl to pour into the United States. I am committed to restoring law and order by securing the border, strengthening immigration enforcement, and ending policies that incentivize illegal immigration. America has always welcomed legal immigrants who follow the rules and contribute to our country, but Washington must finally put the safety and security of American citizens first.  Issues Armed Forces and Defense Environment and the Indian River Lagoon Financial Services Health Care Human Trafficking Immigration Infrastructure Space Tax Reform And The Economy Taxes Veterans

Infrastructure | Congressman Mike Haridopolos Skip to main content Phone:  (202) 225-3671 Email Me Address:  1039 Longworth House Office Building, Washington, DC 20515   Infrastructure Infrastructure is about more than roads and bridges—it’s about economic growth, national security, and preparing America for the future. From modernizing ports and expanding broadband access to strengthening our water systems and supporting the Space Coast’s critical role in America’s space leadership, we need smart investments that deliver real value to taxpayers. I support infrastructure projects that improve daily life, create jobs, and strengthen our economy without adding unnecessary waste and bureaucracy. Human Trafficking | Congressman Mike Haridopolos Skip to main content Phone:  (202) 225-3671 Email Me Address:  1039 Longworth House Office Building, Washington, DC 20515   Human Trafficking Human trafficking is a serious crime that threatens vulnerable individuals and undermines our communities. Florida remains a key state in the fight against trafficking, requiring strong coordination between law enforcement, community organizations, and policymakers. I support strengthening penalties for traffickers, supporting victims with the resources they need to recover, and improving prevention efforts through education and awareness. Financial Services | Congressman Mike Haridopolos Skip to main content Phone:  (202) 225-3671 Email Me Address:  1039 Longworth House Office Building, Washington, DC 20515   Financial Services Strong, well-functioning financial institutions are essential to our economy, powering small businesses, family homeownership, job creation, and long-term prosperity on the Space Coast. I support commonsense regulation that preserves safe and responsible lending, stimulates economic growth and innovation, and keeps America competitive in emerging technologies like AI and fintech. At the same time, we must protect consumers and investors from fraud, scams, and abuse while cutting unnecessary red tape that drives up costs and slows opportunity. My commonsense principles are strongly reflected in my “Greenlighting Growth Act” (H.R. 3343) passed by the House, that will cut red tape and promote expansion for small, high-growth businesses.
